name: citation_management
description: Citation management is a scholarly metadata database primitive for discovering papers, resolving DOI/PMID/arXiv identifiers, enriching bibliographic records, formatting BibTeX, deduplicating entries, and validating references for scientific writing.
capabilities: Resolve identifiers into bibliographic records and BibTeX.
Deduplicate, enrich, and validate citations before manuscript or review delivery.
requirements: Network access to the selected scholarly metadata APIs.
DOI, PMID, arXiv ID, title, or other searchable identifier when available.
Citation style and target venue when formatting is required.
